scenarios.name: Lane Forecast — observation.forecast contains the wave-1 Spore Tick swarm at elapsedMs=0
scenarios.description: AC-2: at elapsedMs ≈ 0 of the 2026-04-28 challenge, observation.forecast has exactly one entry — Spore Tick × 5 on row 2 with atMs=4500. The Briar Beetle at offsetMs=11000 is outside the 6 s horizon.

scenarios.name: Lane Forecast — marker resolves on spawn
scenarios.description: AC-4: setTimeScale(8) and poll until survivedMs ≥ 4800; the wave-1 swarm entry is no longer in __gameTestHooks.getForecast().

scenarios.name: Lane Forecast — determinism with forecast on vs off
scenarios.description: AC-5: the prior-roster replay is driven twice — once with the forecast on, once with ?testDisableForecast=1 — and the final observation excluding the forecast field is identical.

scenarios.name: Lane Forecast — getForecast() round-trips through the IR9 single gate
scenarios.description: Both getObservation().forecast and __gameTestHooks.getForecast() route through PlayScene.getForecastSnapshot(); no parallel logic.

scenarios.name: Lane Forecast — forecast hides on game-over and challenge clear
scenarios.description: AC-6, AC-7: when gameEnding, challengeCleared, endlessActive, or phase !== 'scripted', the snapshot is empty and the layer hides.

scenarios.name: Lane Forecast — IR4 swarm dedupe (one marker per swarmGroupId)
scenarios.description: AC-8: only the first member of each swarm group is emitted; later members are represented by the swarmCount on the leader.

notes: Six representative Lane Forecast checks tied to the AC-2/AC-4/AC-5/AC-6/AC-7/AC-8 acceptance criteria; full Playwright suite exercises the same surface end-to-end.
